description: Looking for wireless headphones with long battery life? The boAt Rockerz Prime 415 brings up to 120 hours playback, 360 Spatial Audio, 40mm drivers, and 40ms low latency, making it a compelling value pick under Rs. 2,000.
title: boAt Rockerz Prime 415: 5 Reasons It Makes a Strong Case for the Battery-Life Crown

description: A US federal judge has denied Sam Bankman-Fried’s request for a new trial, stating that the motion lacked new evidence. The development comes as the former FTX CEO continues to pursue legal remedies following his conviction in one of the largest crypto fraud cases.
title: US Judge Rejects Former FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried’s Bid for New Trial

description: Hours after OpenAI and Microsoft revealed the amended non-exclusive partnership, the ChatGPT maker has started forging new partnerships. On Monday, the San Francisco-based artificial intelligence (AI) giant announced a multi-year strategic partnership with Amazon and its cloud division, Amazon Web Services (AWS). The multi-faceted deal brings the latest OpenAI AI models to AWS customers.
title: OpenAI, Amazon Announce Multi-Year Strategic Partnership as Microsoft’s Exclusive Deal Ends

description: AirDrop support on Android through Quick Share is expanding to more brands, including Oppo and Vivo models. The feature allows direct file sharing between Android phones and iPhones once AirDrop visibility is enabled. It was previously limited to Pixel and Samsung Galaxy devices. While transfer speeds may be slower than native methods, the feature simplifies cross-platform sharing. The rollout appears to be gradual, with recent updates enabling the feature on select devices and suggesting wider availability in the future.
title: AirDrop via Quick Share Reportedly Expands to Oppo Find X9 Ultra, Vivo X300 Ultra

description: A new report highlights changing smartphone buying trends in India, with users focusing more on experience, value, and everyday usability. It finds that 89 percent of buyers consider AI features, while performance, camera, and battery life are now standard expectations. Price and value remain key drivers, with many users opting for EMI options. The report also notes longer upgrade cycles and rising interest in design.
title: Smartphone Buyers in India Prioritise AI and Real-World Usage, Flipkart Report Shows

description: OnePlus has confirmed the sale date and availability details of Nord CE 6 and Nord CE 6 Lite in India. They will launch in the country on May 7 at 12pm. Both phones are confirmed to ship with a 50-megapixel primary rear camera. They will be available through Amazon India, the OnePlus India online store, the OnePlus Experience Stores, and other retail outlets. The OnePlus Nord CE 6 will run on the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chip, while the Nord CE 6 Lite will pack a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Apex chipset.
title: OnePlus Nord CE 6, Nord CE 6 Lite Availability Details Announced Ahead of May 7 Launch Date

description: Valve has said that it's "hard at work" on the Steam Deck 2. The company has not shared any details about the next-gen Steam handheld. Valve plans to launch the Steam Machine, its PC/console hybrid, this year. Earlier this week, the company announced the launch date for the new Steam controller.
title: Valve Says It's 'Hard at Work' on Steam Deck 2

description: Google Pixel 11 series is expected to be powered by the tech giant's next-generation Tensor G6 chipset. While the company has yet to confirm its launch, a tipster has shared the details about the unreleased SoC, suggesting that it will be significantly more powerful than its predecessor. Moreover, the Tensor G6 SoC will reportedly feature a seven-core CPU, comprising two ARM C1-Pro efficiency cores clocked at 2.65Hz, four ARM C1-Pro performance cores clocked at 3.38GHz, and one ARM C1-Ultra prime core, delivering a clock speed of 4.11GHz.
title: Google Pixel 11 Series’ Tensor G6 Chipset Could Be Significantly Faster Than Last Year’s Tensor G5 SoC, Leak Suggests

description: Possible launch timeline and specifications of the Oppo Reno 16 Pro have leaked online. It is said to go official between July and August this year. It is tipped to feature a 6.32-inch OLED panel and a triple rear camera unit including a 200-megapixel sensor. It is tipped to have a glass and aluminium build and an OnePlus-inspired action button. The battery could see slight improvements over the existing model.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Pro Key Specifications Leaked; Tipped to Launch in H2 2026

description: RedStone has launched a settlement layer aimed at enabling tokenised real-world assets to be used as collateral in DeFi lending. The system introduces an on-chain auction mechanism to address liquidity challenges and unlock idle RWA capital within decentralised finance.
title: RedStone Launches Settlement Layer For DeFi Lending, Aims to Use Tokenised RWAs

description: Xiaomi 17T Pro and Xiaomi 17T will be powered by different MediaTek Dimensity chipsets, according to a tipster. While the Pro model is said to be powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 9500 SoC, the standard variant could ship with the MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra chipset. Both phones will reportedly feature triple rear camera units, led by 50-megapixel main shooters, 50-megapixel telephoto cameras, and 12-megapixel ultrawide cameras. While the Xiaomi 17T Pro is said to feature a 7,000mAh battery, the Xiaomi 17T could get a 6,500mAh cell.
title: Xiaomi 17T Pro, Xiaomi 17T Leak Reveals Price and Features, Leaving Little to the Imagination Ahead of Debut

description: Stranger Things: Tales from '85 is a new chapter set in Hawkins with fresh mysteries and adventures.
title: Stranger Things: Tales from '85 Now Available for Streaming on Netflix

description: Anthropic appears to be focusing on design and creativity-focused tasks. After releasing Claude Design, a new design and visual output-focused artificial intelligence (AI) tool last week, the company is now releasing a set of new connectors to allow its chatbot to perform complex creativity tasks in third-party platforms. These connectors were developed in partnership with several software brands, including Adobe, Autodesk, Blender, and more.
title: Anthropic’s Claude Can Now Complete Creative Tasks in Adobe, Blender and Autodesk

description: Samsung is reportedly reviewing possible changes to the Galaxy S27 series, focusing on camera layout and internal design. A leak suggests the company is studying how the camera setup and internal components can be adjusted together. The move could be linked to adding built-in magnets for Qi2 wireless charging and accessory support, which may require structural changes. However, the plan remains under evaluation, and rising component costs could delay or limit any redesign in the upcoming lineup.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Tipped to Arrive With Redesigned Camera Layout to Accomodate Qi2 Magnetic Charging

description: Off Campus is a college romance series about love, friendship, and hockey life at Briar University.
title: Off Campus OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch This Romantic Series Online?

description: Google Translate turned 20 on April 28, the Mountain View-based tech giant announced on Tuesday. As part of the celebrations, the company introduced a new tool for the platform, dubbed Pronunciation Practice, which is currently available for Android users in the US and India, with support for three languages, including English, Spanish, and Hindi. On the occasion, Google’s Chief Executive Officer (CEO), Sundar Pichai, said that the platform has shifted its reliance to Google’s Gemini AI models to provide more accurate results.
title: Google Translate Turns 20: Pronunciation Practice Feature Rolls Out to Celebrate Translate's 20th Anniversary

description: Another set of Moto G87 renders has leaked, showing a familiar design. The renders show the phone in blue and black colourways with a hole-punch display design. It is tipped to feature a 200-megapixel rear camera sensor, marking a significant upgrade over the Moto G77 and Moto G67. It could launch soon with a  MediaTek Dimensity 6000 series chipset. The company is likely to release the phone in six colour options.
title: Moto G87 Tipped to Feature 200-Megapixel Camera; Leaked Renders Hint at Familiar Design Again

description: Oppo F33 5G has gone on sale in India starting today, after launching earlier this month alongside its Pro variant. The smartphone features a 6.57-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate and is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6360 Max chipset. It packs a 7,000mAh battery with 80W fast charging and offers IP66, IP68, and IP69 ratings. The phone includes a 50-megapixel main camera and is available in multiple storage variants through online and offline channels.
title: Oppo F33 5G With 7,000mAh Battery, MediaTek Dimensity 6360 Max SoC Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Rebel Wolves and Bandai Namco have revealed a new story trailer and gameplay overview for their upcoming vampire action-RPG The Blood of Dawnwalker. The developer also confirmed a release date for the game. The Blood of Dawnwalker is releasing September 3, 2026, across Steam, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X.
title: The Blood of Dawnwalker Release Date Announced, New Gameplay and Story Trailer Revealed

description: A delivery boy’s journey through love, heartbreak, and family healing forms the soul of Thiruchitrambalam.
title: Thiruchitrambalam OTT Release: Where to Watch Dhanush’s Romantic Tamil Hit Online

description: Apple on Tuesday announced a new payment model for auto-renewing subscriptions on the App Store. As per the Cupertino-based tech giant, it is aimed at offering users more flexible pricing options alongside ensuring long-term revenue for developers. As part of the initiative, customers will be able to commit to a 12-month subscription to a service while paying for it on a monthly basis, eliminating the upfront annual fees.
title: Apple Announces Monthly Payment Option for Annual Subscriptions on App Store

description: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has addressed the concerns around GTA 6 price, suggesting the game would deliver value for money for consumers. Industry analysts have speculated GTA 6 being priced around $100, but Zelnick said that Take-Two was committed to making the "most spectacular piece of entertainment on Earth.” — “If we do that, and if we’re of service to our customers, then the upside will take care of itself,” he said.
title: Take-Two CEO Addresses GTA 6 Price, Says Company Focussed on Ensuring 'Reasonable' Prices for Its Games

description: Party speakers in India now combine high output, lighting effects, and karaoke features for home and outdoor use. Options like the boAt PartyPal 600 and Portronics Iron Beats IV deliver up to 250W output, while models like the JBL PartyBox Club 120 add premium features such as app control and longer battery life. Most speakers support Bluetooth, USB, AUX, and TWS pairing. Battery life ranges from 6 to 12 hours, and features like wireless mics, RGB lights, and guitar inputs enhance the overall experience.
title: Best Party Speakers in India for Home and Outdoor Use

description: WhatsApp is said to be gearing up to launch its own encrypted cloud storage backup service. This update could offer WhatsApp more control over backup management. With the latest update, Android users will get two choices for backing up their chats: Google Drive or WhatsApp’s own cloud storage. WhatsApp’s own cloud storage could include 2GB of free space. It is likely to be protected by a passkey, a normal password, or a 64-digit encryption key.
title: WhatsApp Working on Its Own Encrypted Cloud Backup to Reduce Reliance on Google Drive: Report

description: Lovable, the popular artificial intelligence (AI)-powered full-stack coding platform, launched its mobile app on Monday. Available on both the Play Store and the App Store, the app brings vibe coding capabilities to smartphones and lets users generate websites and apps on the go. While the mobile app does not come with the full functionality of the website, users can still prompt their ideas, preview the results, and iterate on them.
title: Lovable’s Vibe Coding Platform Is Now Available as an Android and iOS App

description: The Kerala Story 2 is an intense drama film that revolves around three women who get trapped in an interfaith relationship.
title: The Kerala Story 2 OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Tech companies laid off about 38,000 employees in March 2026, according to a report citing data from a layoffs tracker. This reportedly makes it the worst month for tech employees in the past two years. A considerable number of these figures have been attributed to Oracle laying off 30,000 employees in one go, as the tech firm, similar to the rest of the industry, is trying to optimise its workforce to adjust to the new AI realities. Tech companies across the globe have begun adopting AI-powered tools for their day-to-day workflows, replacing blue-collar workers.
title: Tech Layoffs Surge: March Worst Month in Two Years as Companies Slashed 38,000 Jobs, Layoff Tracker Claims

description: Bitcoin traded near $77,300 on Wednesday as investors stayed cautious ahead of the US Federal Reserve decision. ETF outflows and macro uncertainty weighed on sentiment, while analysts say the market remains range-bound between key support and resistance levels.
title: Bitcoin Remains Range Bound Ahead of US Fed Decision and ETF Outflows

description: Vivo is preparing its X500 series, with leaks highlighting the X500 Pro Max’s specifications. The phone is said to feature a 2K display, possibly a 6.9-inch LTPO panel with a 144Hz refresh rate. It may include a 50-megapixel LOFIC primary camera, a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto lens, and a multispectral sensor. The device is expected to run on the MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset and pack a 7,000mAh battery. The lineup could launch in China in September.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Max Being Tested With 2K Display Months Ahead of Anticipated Debut, Tipster Claims

description: Apple has long been rumoured to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the iPhone next year. While the Cupertino-based tech giant is gearing up to introduce the iPhone 18 lineup in September, all eyes are on Apple’s 2027 iPhone. According to a tipster, the purported handset will come with an “entirely new display language”, including an all-curved screen, which could potentially deliver a near-bezel-less viewing experience — a first for the iPhone.
title: Apple’s 20th Anniversary iPhone Tipped to Feature All-Curved Display With Near Bezel-Less Design

description: YouTube is experimenting with a new “Ask YouTube” feature. This experiment is live now and is available to YouTube Premium subscribers in the US aged 18 and older. It also lets users ask follow-up questions. The feature shows a button within the search bar, and tapping this button will show suggested prompts. YouTube says it is working to offer this Ask YouTube feature to non-Premium users in the future.
title: YouTube Tests 'Ask YouTube' AI Chatbot That Offers Smart Responses With Videos, Shorts

description: OpenAI has recently fallen short of targets for user growth and revenue, raising concerns among some executives about whether it can fund its heavy data centre investments, according to the Wall Street Journal. The report also says OpenAI missed several monthly revenue goals earlier this year after ceding ground to Anthropic in coding and enterprise segments in key technology markets.
title: OpenAI Falls Short of Revenue and User Targets as It Races Toward IPO, WSJ Reports

description: Directed by Abhilash Reddy, Biker is a sports drama film which is now landing on the digital screens soon.
title: Biker OTT Release Date Revealed: Know Everything About Plot, Cast, and More

description: Realme 16x 5G will be launched in India soon with the model number RMX5270, a tipster claims. While the leaker did not share the launch timeline, the colour options and storage configurations of the rumoured Realme 16x 5G have surfaced online. The handset will reportedly be offered in two colour options, dubbed Endurance Brown and Glory White. Moreover, the new Realme 16 series smartphone could go on sale in the country in 4GB + 128GB, 6GB + 128GB, and 6GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations. More details could be revealed in the coming months.
title: Realme 16x 5G India Launch Seems Imminent as Storage Options, Colourways Surface Online

description: Motorola’s 2026 foldable smartphone lineup is expected to be unveiled soon. While the company has yet to confirm the exact models, the rumour mill suggests that the upcoming lineup may include the Motorola Razr 2026, Razr+ 2026, and Razr Ultra 2026. Ahead of their anticipated unveiling, the Motorola Razr+ 2026 has surfaced in leaked renders and lifestyle images, offering an early look at the company’s upcoming clamshell foldable.
title: Motorola Razr+ 2026 Leaked Renders Show Bigger Cover Screen, Design Changes

description: Apple is said to be preparing a major overhaul of the photo editing features on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. According to a seasoned journalist, the Cupertino-based tech giant is leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) to catch up and compete with its Android rivals. It is reportedly developing a new suite of tools for iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27 operating systems, which are likely to be previewed at WWDC 2026 before being publicly released later this Fall.
title: Apple Reportedly Developing New AI-Powered Photo Editing Tools for iPhone, iPad, and Mac
